preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The length of the permutation is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the permutation is an integer between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: All elements in a permutation are distinct.
The sum of all values of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements in all permutations does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The number of subsequences is at most the minimum integer k such that every permutation of length n can be partitioned into at most k monotonic subsequences.

postconditions.expression: Each subsequence is either increasing or decreasing.
postconditions.description: Each subsequence in the partition is monotonic.

postconditions.expression: Each element of the permutation belongs to exactly one subsequence.
postconditions.description: Every element in the permutation is included in exactly one of the subsequences.

postconditions.expression: The output must be a valid partition of the permutation into monotonic subsequences.
postconditions.description: The output must be a valid way to split the permutation into subsequences where each subsequence is either increasing or decreasing.
